request.style: English, male baritone solo, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, warm strings, hopeful and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse
From his roots a branch will bear fruit
The Spirit of the LORD will rest on him
Wisdom and understanding fill his view

[Chorus]
The Spirit of counsel and might
The Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD
His delight will be in the fear of the LORD
Righteousness and justice are his song

[Verse]
He will not judge by what his eyes see
Nor decide by what his ears hear
With righteousness he will judge the poor
And with justice decide for the lowly of the earth

[Chorus]
The Spirit of counsel and might
The Spirit of knowledge and the fear of the LORD
His delight will be in the fear of the LORD
Righteousness and justice are his song

[Bridge]
Righteousness will be the belt around his waist
Faithfulness the sash around his hips
He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth
And slay the wicked with the breath of his lips

[Outro]
A shoot from the stump of Jesse
A branch bearing fruit
The Spirit rests on him
